findings.message: L1 (regulator U4) peak 0.682 A / RMS 0.53 A vs rated 0.77 A (power model nlcv32t-2r2m): 11% margin on the peak
findings.suggestion: choose an inductor rated ≥ 1.3× Ipk (saturation), or confirm Isat separately from the thermal Irms rating

findings.message: J2 draws 0.43 A from USB (usb-only) vs the 0.5 A budget (86%) — little margin for inrush/radio bursts
findings.suggestion: a host port may current-limit or brown out; declare usbBudgetA in the spec if the source advertises more

findings.message: D1 (SS34) conducts 0.427 A: Vf ≈ 0.364 V, loss 0.155 W (terminal-only)
findings.suggestion: if the downstream headroom matters, an ideal-diode controller or P-MOSFET OR-ing removes most of this drop

findings.message: D2 (SS34) conducts 0.43 A: Vf ≈ 0.364 V, loss 0.157 W (usb-only)
findings.suggestion: if the downstream headroom matters, an ideal-diode controller or P-MOSFET OR-ing removes most of this drop

findings.message: impedance-controlled nets: USB_DM 90 Ω, USB_DP 90 Ω — order the board with the stackup the widths were solved for (JLC04161H-7628 (4-layer 1.6 mm, L1→L2 prepreg 0.2104 mm))
U4 buck: Vin min 4.593 V → 3.318 V, duty ≤ 82%

assumptions: DC operating point (MNA + Newton-Raphson): capacitors open, inductors = DCR, switching regulators averaged by power balance; not a transient simulation
IC signal pins are high-impedance (no DC drive) unless a GPIO drives an LED network
loads are constant-current above a knee voltage and resistive below it (unpowered rails draw nothing)
J1: input source 5V_TERM = 5.00 V (net name) with 0.02 Ω series resistance
J2: input source VBUS = 5.00 V (model) with 0.1 Ω series resistance
momentary switches are released (open) except in buttons-pressed
U1.IO2 (LED_CTRL) assumed driven high (LED1 on) through 40 Ω output resistance
SW1 closed: momentary switch pressed in buttons-pressed
SW2 closed: momentary switch pressed in buttons-pressed

definitions.voltage: V over the solved DC scenarios: nom = typical, min/max = envelope, peak = highest instantaneous (switch node swings to Vin; AC = √2·Vrms)
definitions.currentA: sizing current (A): simulated worst-case DC net current, switch-node ripple RMS, or a declared/heuristic budget (currentSource)
definitions.widthMil: IPC-2221/2152 width for currentA at tempRiseC: outer on outerOz, inner on innerOz; min = narrowest allowed neck (largest single-pin branch current, class floor); diff/RF = impedance width
definitions.clearanceMil: IPC-2221B B2 (B4 when coated) for the net's peak voltage to its own reference, never below the fab clearance; domain-to-domain insulation is in pairs[]
definitions.pairs: insulation between domains that an isolation part bridges; numbers from SafetyDistances(pair, standard)

why: routed edge: outer copper ≥ 20 mil (0.5 mm), inner planes ≥ 30 mil (0.76 mm) — engineering default above the JLC 0.2 mm floor (docs/pcb-design-rules.md §5.4)
no hazardous, mains or patient domain: SELV copper uses the layer defaults
